question.knowledge_point: Finding the Image of a Point or Segment
question.problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14095879/assets/f573a36be6a90a61b0d2b711b2eab5f630464bc1ecfad75cdccd9cf9cb62aa77.png)

Consider the segment $\overset{―}{PQ}$ above, and the transformation $T$ defined as

$$
x=v-2u-3,\,y=u+2v-1.
$$

The image of $\overset{―}{PQ}$ under the action of $T$ is the segment $\overset{―}{{P}^{′}{Q}^{′}}$ in the $xy$-plane. Which of the following diagrams shows $\overset{―}{{P}^{′}{Q}^{′}}?$
question.worked_solution:
An affine transformation $T:{R}^{2}\to {R}^{2}$ is a function of the form

$$
x=Au+b,
$$

where $x,u,$ and $b$ are column vectors in ${R}^{2},$ and $A$ is a $2\times 2$ matrix.

Notice that we can express the given transformation as

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}v-2u-3 \\ u+2v-1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2u+v \\ u+2v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ -1\end{aligned}] \\  & ={{[\begin{aligned}-2 & 1 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{A}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{u}+{{[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ -1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{b}\end{aligned}
$$

The transformation $T$ maps the endpoints of $\overset{―}{PQ}$ to the endpoints of $\overset{―}{{P}^{′}{Q}^{′}}.$ So, to find the image of $\overset{―}{PQ},$ we find the images of each endpoint.

To quickly carry out this calculation, we set up the following matrices:

- The matrix $U$ containing the endpoints of our segment:

$$
U=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 \\ 1 & -1\end{aligned}]
$$

- The matrix $B$ that has the same shape as $U$ and with the vector $b$ in each column:

$$
B=[\begin{aligned}-3 & -3 \\ -1 & -1\end{aligned}]
$$

The image of $u$ under $T$ is given by $Au+b.$ So, by applying $T$ to $U,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}AU+B & =[\begin{aligned}-2 & 1 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 \\ 1 & -1\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-3 & -3 \\ -1 & -1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3 & -5 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-3 & -3 \\ -1 & -1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0 & -8 \\ 0 & -1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the endpoints of the image in the $xy$-plane are $(0,0)$ and $(-8,-1).$

Drawing this segment in the $xy$-plane, we get the following:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14095879/assets/bce5c5155a7e8f1f257b85712627d44dfcc467911a6638016bc3df5892054fef.png)
